name: to-paper
description: Code to Paper: replicate a running page as a pixel-accurate, editable static layout in Paper from extracted DOM and computed styles.

steps.name: Session init (once per session)
steps.instruction: Before any mutation: load the Paper guide, file info and tokens, resolve {prefix}, {token_files}, {framework} and {font}, and confirm the font. Paper disconnected: stop with setup steps, no fallback canvas.
checklist: Project conventions resolved, each with its source

steps.name: Source audit (once per page)
steps.instruction: Run the page, take the full-page reference screenshot, read the rendered DOM and computed styles in a browser, and inventory every image.

steps.name: Token mapping
steps.instruction: Map every extracted value to a Paper token; record values with no token.
checklist: Every color, size and radius mapped or flagged

steps.name: Canvas layout
steps.instruction: Place the artboard on the target page without overlapping existing artboards.

steps.name: Build
steps.instruction: Write HTML one visual group per call from the extracted DOM. Images via paper-asset:// paths. Resting states only; motion as frame strips.
checklist: Every section built from extracted DOM

steps.name: Verify
steps.instruction: Compare the artboard screenshot with the reference screenshot, fix divergences, run the font sweep, then finish_working_on_nodes.

tone: Precise. Every pixel value comes from the source. No creative interpretation.
